resources.string: App lock keeps the apps you chose closed until your morning is proven; it only notices which app opens, and unlocks on its own after a few hours. Night guard (if you set an alarm) stops half-asleep you from uninstalling or force-stopping SoulWake: during your guarded hours only, it reads Settings and uninstall screens just to spot SoulWake\'s own page. It never reads your messages or passwords, and nothing is stored or sent.
